title: Mezzrow's French popularity and his book
summary: Mezzrow never played in France but was fashionable for a year because of his book; his first concert succeeded, then Bechet displaced him.

blocks.x: No, I haven't heard of Mesereau. He didn't play in France. He didn't play in France. He didn't play in France. But I think he was quite loved at some point. He came to... There was a fashion mode also, especially at the time when he wrote his book. And for a year, Mesereau was very fashion in France. And then, we talked about it. I don't even know what it became.

Did you... I couldn't understand much of it. Do you think that his fame is due to his writing letters to critics and his book? Did you say? His book, yes. Yes. But what do people think of his actual playing? Do they like his playing of his instrument?

Yes. He... Lorsqu'il est venu, oui, le premier concert qu'il a donné, il a eu beaucoup de succès. Mais... Ça n'a pas duré longtemps. Parce que Bechet est arrivé tout de suite après et Bechet a remplacé Mesereau dans le cœur des gens. He l'avait...
As long as the book was popular.
Yeah. Did you think of anything that I asked? I'm running out of questions that I don't understand. Yeah. Range.
